test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**reality'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reality** means **that exists**.

 
 
• Example - ***Child marriage exists in reality***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be,** Individual people and the administration must work cooperatively to make this a reality.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dream** means **a goal or a strong desire**.

 
 
• Example -*** It's my dream to travel to Paris at least once***.
 
 
 
• **Truth** means **sincere or honest.**
 
 
• Example - ***The man soon revealed the truth***.
 
 
 
• **Fiction** means **a made-up story**.
 
 
• Example - ***Harry Potter is a fantasy fiction***.
